environment.network: Local production preview; no network or CPU throttling

methodology: Production Playground, scikit-learn paper, default Reader with TOC/sidebar/plugins. Three isolated pages per mode and viewport. Fonts ready before mode activation; activation includes menu/protocol and lazy module load, not navigation. Three 120-step down/up sweeps; first encounters uncached paragraphs. Scroll/resize frame timing ends at next rAF (not a completed paint); settled resize additionally waits four identical visible-layout frames. Twelve 390–1380px viewport changes include actual content-width changes. Raw samples, CDP scroll task time and post-GC heap retained. Native range, text, cached nodes and horizontal overflow checked.
